follow-up time: unclear - some follow-up was conducted, duration not stated
cohort: 329 full-term newborns treated with total serum bilirubin (TSB) at a level of 20 mg/dL (342 mumol/L) to 7 neonatal intensive care units in Hebei Province, China over the past 18 months
finding: TSB, B/A and sepsis were risk factors for ABE.
